sqlMap.select: SELECT BUYER ,QUOTATION_NO ,QUOTATION_SEQ ,KEY_3 AS MSDS_NO ,ADD_USER_NAME AS BTOA_USER_NAME ,KEY_1 AS BTOA_USER_DEPT ,KEY_2 AS BTOA_DATE ,KEY_4 AS MSDS_NM ,KEY_5 AS MAKER_NAME ,KEY_6 AS MSDS_URL ,KEY_7 AS COMP_CD FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM KEP.ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE ='PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE ='KRSOLBG001' AND TEXT5 IS NOT NULL) AND IF_FLAG ='N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'T' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND MSDS_YN = 'Y' AND MSDS_STATUS ='C' AND MSDS_NO IS NOT NULL AND QUOTATION_NO = #QUOTATION_NO# AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #QUOTATION_SEQ#
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #IF_FLAG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND IF_FLAG ='N' AND QUOTATION_NO = #QUOTATION_NO# AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #QUOTATION_SEQ#
sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT BUYER, INV_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM KEP.ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE ='PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE ='KRSOLBG001' AND TEXT3 IS NOT NULL) AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND ROWNUM <= 10 ) GROUP BY BUYER, INV_NO ORDER BY BUYER, INV_NO
SELECT BUYER ,INV_NO ,INV_SEQ ,LEGACY_PO_NO ,LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,ITEM_QTY ,INV_DATE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND IF_FLAG ='N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #FLAG# , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
